# Cookies and browser storage

> **Draft — lawyer approval required.** Generated from the code. Policy version 2026-11-19.2, 2026-11-19.

This policy covers the Curahold website, the product, the customer portal, the documentation and the demo. The controller is [Company legal name], [address]. It lists everything we store on your device or load from another company, because the law treats browser storage (localStorage, sessionStorage, caches) and pixels the same way as cookies.

## How we ask

- Nothing optional is stored or loaded before you choose. Analytics and marketing are off until you switch them on.
- Accept all, Reject all and Choose are offered side by side with the same weight. Rejecting is as easy as accepting, and the site works the same either way.
- Each optional category has its own switch. Nothing is ticked in advance.
- Your choice is remembered for 12 months, and we ask again sooner when this policy gets a new version.
- We keep a record of each choice (the version and a fingerprint of the text you saw, the time, the country and your choice) to be able to prove it. For visitors who are not signed in the record holds a random id, not your name.
- The banner appears only when something optional is actually in use; when nothing is, there is nothing to ask.

## Categories

- **Strictly necessary** — Needed for the service you asked for: signing in, security, remembering your cookie choice, payment. No consent is needed; they cannot be switched off.
- **Preferences** — Written only when you change a setting yourself (language, theme, a view or a filter). They stay on your device. No consent is needed.
- **Analytics** — Counting visits and how pages are used, to improve the website and the product. Only with your consent.
- **Marketing** — Measuring our advertising and building advertising audiences. Off by default in our configuration, and only with your consent.

## Third parties and transfers abroad

A third-party script sends data such as your IP address, browser details and the page you visit to its provider, which may handle it outside your country; that is a transfer abroad and is covered in our Privacy notice (and, for Türkiye, under Article 9 of the KVKK). Each provider's own privacy policy applies to what it collects. We do not sell personal data.

## Changing or withdrawing your choice

Use "Privacy choices" at the bottom of every page of the website, or on your profile page in the product, at any time. Withdrawing is as easy as giving. You can also clear cookies and site data in your browser; you will then be asked again.
